vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your energy attacks deal +1 life card of damage.
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your effects requires you to discard 1 card from your hand during combat. Rejuvenate 2.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
Raise your anger 1 level.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Search your Life Deck for a Styled Drill and place it into play.
